title: Vanishing coefficients away from two sets
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p\in(0,1)$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $S$ be a nonempty set of coordinates different from $\{i\}$. The biased Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the function that returns the sign in coordinate $i$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a nonempty set of coordinates
